title: Diophantine Obstructions, Affine Orthogonal Runge Theorems, and Degree-512 Extraspecial Covers for Multiplicity Five in Pascal's Triangle
field: Diophantine equations and algebraic number theory
decided_scope: Unconditional omega(a) >= 7, K(a) >= 8, and omega(a) >= 14 on {5,6,7,8}, sharp affine orthogonal Runge theorem for G_g = F_2^(2g) semidirect O^+_(2g)(2), two-power theta-tower holomorph image, and degree-512 genus-1537 nonabelian extraspecial 2_+^(1+8) Runge obstruction
open_boundaries: Complete classification of all integers appearing at least five times in Pascal's triangle
